<<<FILE environment/src/reference.c>>>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define MAX_STAFF 200
#define MAX_SHIFTS 200
#define MAX_PREFS 2000
#define MAX_HOLIDAYS 1000
#define MAX_ASSIGNED 200
#define MAX_LINE 512
#define WEEK_MIN 10080

typedef struct {
    char id[32];
    char name[64];
    char role[16];
    char skill[8];
    double max_hrs;
    double total_hours;
    int assigned_count;
    int effective_days[7];
    int assigned_shift_idx[MAX_ASSIGNED];
    int num_assigned;
} Staff;

typedef struct {
    char id[32];
    int day;
    int start_min;
    int end_min;
    char skill[8];
    int slots;
    int duration_min;
    double shift_hours;
    int effective_day;
    int start_abs;
    int end_abs;
    int eligible_count;
    char assigned[MAX_ASSIGNED][32];
    int num_filled;
} Shift;

typedef struct { char staff_id[32], shift_id[32]; int score; } Pref;
typedef struct { char staff_id[32]; int day; } Holiday;

static Staff staff[MAX_STAFF];
static int num_staff = 0;
static Shift shifts[MAX_SHIFTS];
static int num_shifts = 0;
static Pref prefs[MAX_PREFS];
static int num_prefs = 0;
static Holiday holidays[MAX_HOLIDAYS];
static int num_holidays = 0;

static int day_to_num(const char *d) {
    if (!strcmp(d,"Mon")) return 0;
    if (!strcmp(d,"Tue")) return 1;
    if (!strcmp(d,"Wed")) return 2;
    if (!strcmp(d,"Thu")) return 3;
    if (!strcmp(d,"Fri")) return 4;
    if (!strcmp(d,"Sat")) return 5;
    if (!strcmp(d,"Sun")) return 6;
    return -1;
}

static int parse_time(const char *t) {
    int h, m;
    if (sscanf(t, "%d:%d", &h, &m) == 2) return h * 60 + m;
    return -1;
}

static int is_on_holiday(const char *sid, int day) {
    for (int i = 0; i < num_holidays; i++)
        if (!strcmp(holidays[i].staff_id, sid) && holidays[i].day == day) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static int get_pref_score(const char *sid, const char *shid) {
    for (int i = 0; i < num_prefs; i++)
        if (!strcmp(prefs[i].staff_id, sid) && !strcmp(prefs[i].shift_id, shid)) return prefs[i].score;
    return 2;
}

static int pref_weight(int score) {
    if (score <= 2) return 1;
    if (score <= 4) return 2;
    return 3;
}

static int role_bonus(const char *role) {
    if (!strcmp(role, "senior")) return 2;
    return 0;
}

static int count_consecutive(const int *eff, int nd) {
    int w[7];
    memcpy(w, eff, sizeof(w));
    w[nd] = 1;
    int c = 1;
    for (int d = nd - 1; d >= 0 && w[d]; d--) c++;
    for (int d = nd + 1; d <= 6 && w[d]; d++) c++;
    return c;
}

static int check_rest(const Staff *s, const Shift *ns) {
    for (int i = 0; i < s->num_assigned; i++) {
        const Shift *e = &shifts[s->assigned_shift_idx[i]];
        int len_e = e->duration_min, len_ns = ns->duration_min;
        int d = (ns->start_abs - e->start_abs + WEEK_MIN) % WEEK_MIN;
        if (d < len_e || (WEEK_MIN - d) < len_ns) return 0;
        int g1 = (ns->start_abs - e->end_abs + WEEK_MIN) % WEEK_MIN;
        int g2 = (e->start_abs - ns->end_abs + WEEK_MIN) % WEEK_MIN;
        int g = g1 < g2 ? g1 : g2;
        if (g < 660) return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

static int is_eligible(const Staff *s, const Shift *sh) {
    if (strcmp(s->skill, sh->skill)) return 0;
    if (is_on_holiday(s->id, sh->effective_day)) return 0;
    if (s->total_hours + sh->shift_hours > s->max_hrs) return 0;
    if (count_consecutive(s->effective_days, sh->effective_day) > 5) return 0;
    if (!check_rest(s, sh)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

static int is_init_eligible(const Staff *s, const Shift *sh) {
    if (strcmp(s->skill, sh->skill)) return 0;
    if (is_on_holiday(s->id, sh->effective_day)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 2) { fprintf(stderr, "Usage: %s <input_file>\n", argv[0]); return 1; }
    FILE *f = fopen(argv[1], "r");
    if (!f) { fprintf(stderr, "Cannot open %s\n", argv[1]); return 1; }

    char line[MAX_LINE];
    int section = -1;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) {
        line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = '\0';
        if (!line[0]) continue;
        if (!strcmp(line, "STAFF")) { section = 0; continue; }
        if (!strcmp(line, "SHIFTS")) { section = 1; continue; }
        if (!strcmp(line, "PREFERENCES")) { section = 2; continue; }
        if (!strcmp(line, "HOLIDAYS")) { section = 3; continue; }
        if (section == 0) {
            Staff *s = &staff[num_staff];
            char mx[32];
            if (sscanf(line, "%31s %63s %15s %7s %31s", s->id, s->name, s->role, s->skill, mx) == 5) {
                s->max_hrs = atof(mx);
                s->total_hours = 0.0;
                s->assigned_count = 0;
                memset(s->effective_days, 0, sizeof(s->effective_days));
                s->num_assigned = 0;
                num_staff++;
            }
        } else if (section == 1) {
            Shift *sh = &shifts[num_shifts];
            char dy[8], st[8], en[8];
            if (sscanf(line, "%31s %7s %7s %7s %7s %d", sh->id, dy, st, en, sh->skill, &sh->slots) == 6) {
                sh->day = day_to_num(dy);
                sh->start_min = parse_time(st);
                sh->end_min = parse_time(en);
                sh->duration_min = (sh->end_min > sh->start_min)
                    ? (sh->end_min - sh->start_min)
                    : (1440 - sh->start_min + sh->end_min);
                sh->shift_hours = (double)(sh->duration_min / 30) * 0.5;
                sh->effective_day = (sh->start_min >= 1200) ? ((sh->day + 1) % 7) : sh->day;
                sh->start_abs = sh->day * 1440 + sh->start_min;
                sh->end_abs = sh->start_abs + sh->duration_min;
                sh->eligible_count = 0;
                sh->num_filled = 0;
                num_shifts++;
            }
        } else if (section == 2) {
            Pref *p = &prefs[num_prefs];
            if (sscanf(line, "%31s %31s %d", p->staff_id, p->shift_id, &p->score) == 3) num_prefs++;
        } else if (section == 3) {
            Holiday *h = &holidays[num_holidays];
            char dy[8];
            if (sscanf(line, "%31s %7s", h->staff_id, dy) == 2) {
                h->day = day_to_num(dy);
                num_holidays++;
            }
        }
    }
    fclose(f);

    for (int i = 0; i < num_shifts; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < num_staff; j++)
            if (is_init_eligible(&staff[j], &shifts[i])) shifts[i].eligible_count++;

    int order[MAX_SHIFTS];
    for (int i = 0; i < num_shifts; i++) order[i] = i;
    for (int i = 1; i < num_shifts; i++) {
        int key = order[i], j = i - 1;
        while (j >= 0) {
            Shift *a = &shifts[order[j]], *b = &shifts[key];
            int cmp = (a->eligible_count != b->eligible_count)
                ? (a->eligible_count - b->eligible_count)
                : strcmp(a->id, b->id);
            if (cmp > 0) { order[j+1] = order[j]; j--; } else break;
        }
        order[j+1] = key;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < num_shifts; i++) {
        Shift *sh = &shifts[order[i]];
        for (int slot = 0; slot < sh->slots; slot++) {
            int best = -1, best_pri = -1;
            for (int j = 0; j < num_staff; j++) {
                Staff *s = &staff[j];
                int already = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < sh->num_filled; k++)
                    if (!strcmp(sh->assigned[k], s->id)) { already = 1; break; }
                if (already) continue;
                if (!is_eligible(s, sh)) continue;
                int pri = pref_weight(get_pref_score(s->id, sh->id)) + role_bonus(s->role);
                if (best == -1 || pri > best_pri || (pri == best_pri && strcmp(s->id, staff[best].id) < 0)) {
                    best = j;
                    best_pri = pri;
                }
            }
            if (best >= 0) {
                strcpy(sh->assigned[sh->num_filled], staff[best].id);
                sh->num_filled++;
                staff[best].total_hours += sh->shift_hours;
                staff[best].assigned_count++;
                staff[best].effective_days[sh->effective_day] = 1;
                staff[best].assigned_shift_idx[staff[best].num_assigned] = order[i];
                staff[best].num_assigned++;
            } else {
                strcpy(sh->assigned[sh->num_filled], "---");
                sh->num_filled++;
            }
        }
    }

    printf("ROSTER\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < num_shifts; i++) {
        Shift *sh = &shifts[order[i]];
        printf("%s", sh->id);
        for (int j = 0; j < sh->num_filled; j++) printf(" %s", sh->assigned[j]);
        printf("\n");
    }

    printf("SUMMARY\n");
    int idx[MAX_STAFF], n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < num_staff; i++)
        if (staff[i].assigned_count > 0) idx[n++] = i;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int key = idx[i], j = i - 1;
        while (j >= 0) {
            Staff *a = &staff[idx[j]], *b = &staff[key];
            int cmp = (a->total_hours != b->total_hours)
                ? ((a->total_hours < b->total_hours) ? 1 : -1)
                : strcmp(a->id, b->id);
            if (cmp > 0) { idx[j+1] = idx[j]; j--; } else break;
        }
        idx[j+1] = key;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        Staff *s = &staff[idx[i]];
        printf("%s %.1f %s %d\n", s->id, s->total_hours,
               (s->total_hours > 40.0) ? "yes" : "no", s->assigned_count);
    }

    return 0;
}
